audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko.
audit.why: Karma's 950-range Q beats an 800-range Blooming Burst before 6; Pop Blossom (120/105/90) is a genuine level-6 swing Karma has no equivalent to.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma, phases[4..6].side to Neeko, with the level-6-onward whys rewritten to match the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why all describe Karma's own spikes on rows the chart gives to Neeko, and the content layer twice calls Karma's ultimate "non-existent" / "non-damaging".
audit.why: Mantra exists from level 1 and Mantra-Q deals damage — the passive reduces its cooldown off damaging abilities. Calling it non-existent is a factual error a reader will act on.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Pop Blossom's 120/105/90 knockup-and-stun versus Mantra empowering one spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit, no Neeko ability is named beyond the focus token, and the repeated advice to "sidestep it behind minions" is wrong for Tangle-Barbs.
audit.why: Riot's text says the tangle damages and roots everything it passes through and becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting if it kills an enemy or passes through a champion — minions upgrade it rather than stopping it. Separately, Inherent Glamour breaks on immobilizing crowd control, so Karma's W tether root strips the disguise outright, and W also reveals.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 and Pop Blossom 120/105/90; minion advice replaced with lateral dodging; the W-breaks-disguise interaction added to dosFull[2].d.

notes: Chart proposed as one atomic group. The full layer was moved onto the content/packet values, which already agree with each other, so no paired win[N] edit is proposable — win[0..6] already hold the target strings and an edit would fail the exact-before check. Ratings left untouched (could not determine whether phases[N].rating means owner-favourability or matchup severity). Two content-layer factual errors corrected: the page called Karma's ultimate "non-existent" and "non-damaging" — Mantra is available from level 1 and Mantra-Q deals damage. Also corrected the repeated instruction to dodge Tangle-Barbs behind minions; Riot's text has it pass through units and grow on a kill.
